        return

    left = 0
    right = n - 1
    sum_left = l[0]
    sum_right = l[n - 1]
    ops = 0

            left += 1
            right -= 1
            sum_left = l[left]
            sum_right = l[right]

            left += 1

            ops += 1

            right -= 1
            sum_right += l[right]
            ops += 1
